entries.title: Solana claim fixes
entries.summary: Solana claims are more reliable when a recipient needs account setup or a helper pays fees.
highlights: Helper wallets can pay Solana fees without changing the recipient.
Missing recipient USDC accounts are handled before claim.
Claim signing uses fresh Solana transaction data after setup.

entries.title: Bridge flow hardening
entries.summary: Bridge tracking, recovery, and claim execution now handle pending confirmations, Solana recipients, and expired attestations more safely.
highlights: Waits for the source burn transaction to confirm before marking the burn step complete.
Keeps fresh bridge links in recovery while Circle Iris is still indexing or confirming the burn.
Enforces the intended Solana recipient wallet during claim and validates CCTP source and destination domains before signing.
Waits for refreshed attestations to become usable before enabling claim retries.
Prevents execute-intent retries from looping after validation, wallet, or user-rejection failures.

entries.title: New look, history page, and recovery page
entries.summary: The bridge has a refreshed dark interface with clearer places to review transfer history and recover transactions.
highlights: Updated the bridge, tracking, wallet, and form layouts with a cleaner design.
Made transfer history easier to review when returning to the app.
Added a dedicated recovery path for finding or restoring pending transactions.

entries.title: More consistent network icons
entries.summary: Supported networks now render with more reliable icon fallbacks, even when upstream icon metadata is incomplete.
highlights: Improved network icon handling across bridge forms and transaction views.
Added fallback display support for newer supported networks.
Updated chain metadata so routes stay recognizable when icons are missing.

entries.title: More reliable Solana claims
entries.summary: Solana claim handling is more resilient, with clearer completion state and fewer failed claim attempts.
highlights: Improved Solana claim confirmation before marking a transfer complete.
Reduced errors caused by missing or incomplete Solana account metadata.
Made pending claim status less likely to appear stale after a mint completes.

entries.title: Improved transaction recovery
entries.summary: Pending transfers are easier to add back into the app and recover when a claim needs another attempt.
highlights: Added a clearer flow for adding pending bridge transactions.
Improved recovery state for transfers that need a refreshed attestation.
Tightened address checks so recovered transactions are matched to the intended destination.

entries.title: Better bridge tracking
entries.summary: Transfer tracking now has clearer status updates across burn, attestation, and mint steps.
highlights: Added richer bridge tracking pages for pending transactions.
Improved transfer polling so status changes appear more consistently.
Made claim readiness and completion states easier to follow.

entries.title: Expanded network coverage metadata
entries.summary: The app now uses generated Circle and BridgeKit metadata with app-managed routing to support and display a broader set of CCTP routes more reliably.
highlights: Improved route discovery and chain display for supported CCTP networks.
Added app-managed network metadata for mainnet and matching testnet routes.
Improved fallback behavior when a public RPC endpoint is unavailable.

entries.title: Automatic re-attestation support
entries.summary: Expired attestations can be refreshed, reducing stuck or failed claim attempts.
highlights: Added recovery support when an attestation expires before claim.
Improved retry handling for claims that need a fresh attestation.
Reduced manual recovery work for long-running transfers.
